description: This file defines the LangException class, a custom exception used in the SuiteCRM project. It extends the built-in Exception class and implements the LangExceptionInterface. The class encapsulates an optional LangText object for localized error messages.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\LangException
classes.description: A custom exception class for language-specific errors, supporting localization through an optional LangText object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message, code, previous exception, and an optional LangText for localization.

methods.name: getLangMessage
methods.description: Returns the localized message if available.
